description: This is a shell script (bash) used for generating certificates, keys, and trust stores for the Eclipse Hono project. It automates the creation of root, CA, device, and service certificates and sets up trust stores and key stores with specified configurations.

methods.name: create_key
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic key (EC or RSA) and saves it to a file.

methods.name: create_cert
methods.description: Creates a certificate signing request and signs it with the CA key to produce a certificate, optionally adding it to a keystore.

methods.name: create_client_cert
methods.description: Creates a client certificate for a device, signed by the default tenant CA.
